name: Advanced Queue Mail - Mailer Plus
description: Routes Advanced Queue Mail notifications through Mailer Plus (Symfony Mailer), supporting both 1.x and 2.x.
project_description: Advanced Queue Mail - Mailer Plus is a submodule of Advanced Queue Mail that replaces the core mail sender with Mailer Plus (formerly Symfony Mailer). When enabled it overrides the advancedqueue_mail.mail_sender service via a ServiceProvider, detecting whether Mailer Plus 1.x (EmailFactoryInterface) or 2.x (MailerPlusInterface) is installed and wiring the matching sender. Job-event emails are then built as typed emails under the base tag advancedqueue_mail with sub-types on_success, on_retry and on_failure, so administrators can configure subject, body, recipients and formatting through Mailer Plus policies (including HTML templates and attachments) instead of the plain text templates used by the core mail path.
